bootstrap: Paired nonparametric target bootstrap, reranking both fixed-model scores in each resample
review_selection: Top two by BLS rank for BLS-only; otherwise hybrid rank, with TIC ties. Positives are selected by membership in primary all-sector top-100 lists. False positives and backgrounds are the two highest hybrid-ranked members of their groups.
status: Reporting plan fixed after inspection of aggregate independent results, before object review. These additions are post-evaluation analyses, not newly preregistered hypotheses.
